paragraphs: Sakana Fugu is a product from Sakana AI that Sakana describes as a multi-agent orchestration system delivered as a single foundation model. Sakana says Fugu is itself a language model trained to call various LLMs in an agent pool, including instances of itself recursively, and that it dynamically orchestrates the world's best models to tackle complex, multi-step tasks through a single API. According to Sakana, Fugu decides how to handle a request, solving it directly when that is enough or assembling and coordinating a team of expert models when a task calls for more, managing model selection, delegation, verification, and synthesis internally.

The family has grown over time. Sakana Fugu opened an early beta in April 2026, reached general availability in June 2026 with Fugu Ultra v1, and was followed by Fugu-Ultra v1.1 in July 2026. At launch Sakana Fugu came in two models, Fugu and Fugu Ultra, and Sakana later released Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2 in September 2026. Fugu Max is optimized for cost and performance at the Pareto Frontier, while Fugu Ultra v2 pushes peak performance on complex, multi-step tasks. Sakana also lists Fugu-Cyber and a Claude Code interface, and related products Sakana Chat and Sakana Marlin.

Sakana offers the models through APIs, including a single OpenAI-compatible API and Claude Code-compatible endpoints, and states that Fugu is also available on platforms such as OpenRouter and Vercel. Sakana says Fugu balances strong performance with low latency, that Fugu Ultra is tuned for maximum answer quality on hard, multi-step problems, and that users can opt specific agents out of the pool for data, privacy, compliance, or organizational requirements.

price_limits.summary: Across the 3 versions, input prices run from $2 to $5 per million tokens and output prices from $6 to $30. Fugu Max is the cheapest, at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. Fugu Ultra v2 has the largest context window, 1,000,000 tokens.

family_reading.text: Sakana Fugu is an API only family, so there are no open weights to download or self host, and every version is reached through a provider. All 3 versions support reasoning and share a 1000000 token context window with a 128000 token maximum output, which suits long documents, large codebases, or multi file inputs. Inputs accept file, image, and text, and output is text only. The spread is narrow: Fugu Max costs $2 per million input and $6 output, while Fugu Ultra and Fugu Ultra v2 cost $5 input and $30 output, so the Ultra tier is the expensive option for heavy generation. The facts suggest the family fits long context reasoning and document or image analysis work, while budgets and offline or self hosted use are the clear limits.
